column4: Throttle a scroll handler in JavaScript so it runs at most once every 200 ms. Show the code.
Flatten a list of lists by one level in Python.
Add a 5 second timeout to a fetch call in JavaScript.
This throws when user is null: const name = user.profile.name; Fix it so name falls back to "guest".
Turn a title like "Hello, World!" into a URL slug like "hello-world" in Python.
Write an LRU cache class in Python with get and put in O(1), a maximum size, and an optional time-to-live per entry.
Write an Express route that returns a paginated list of orders from PostgreSQL using keyset pagination on created_at and id, with a limit parameter and a cursor the client passes back.

Write a small command-line argument parser in Go without third-party packages. It should support boolean flags, flags with values, a help message generated from the definitions, and positional arguments.

Why did adding an index make my INSERTs slower?
What is the difference between git stash pop and git stash apply?

What is a race condition, and how do I usually prevent one?
We are choosing between PostgreSQL and MongoDB for a new product catalogue with varied attributes per product. Compare them for this use and say which you would pick.

Our checkout service returned errors for 40 minutes after a deploy that changed a database connection setting. Write a blameless incident summary with timeline placeholders, likely cause, and follow-up actions.
